blocking.summary: eval/finding events leave criterion_id unclipped for out-of-contract ids: normalizeCriterionId's non-empty result is used verbatim in noteFinding, skipping the documented 100-char clip that only applies on the empty-id fallback branch.

backlogged.summary: repro_program has no documented or enforced length cap: cmdName() returns the raw last path segment of the first token verbatim, so a repro whose first word is a very long string with no path separator lands in the event unbounded, unlike criterion_id/dimension/summary/problems which all have a stated cut length.
